clips.send: A guy sends this to his workout partner who's been exhausted and irritable for months - recognition, anxiety.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, a hormone specialist lists what low testosterone actually feels like: trouble burning fat, lower libido, brain fog, worse sleep, a harder time building muscle, even low-grade irritability that doesn't seem to have a cause.

His point: most men chalk this up to getting older or working too hard, when it's a hormone number a simple blood panel can catch.

The fix starts with a number, not a guess.

How many of these have you been blaming on stress instead of testing for?

clips.send: A woman sends this to her sister in menopause who's only ever had her testosterone checked, never her thyroid.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, a hormone specialist says most people who start testosterone therapy never had their thyroid checked at all - even though it runs the rest of the hormone system.

His advice for women going through menopause: creatine and simple diet changes can help before jumping straight to hormone therapy, but every hormone, including thyroid, needs checking starting in your 30s and 40s.

One test almost everyone skips, standing right in front of the one most people ask for.

Has your doctor ever actually checked your thyroid?
